title: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: Creamy Italian pasta made with eggs, cheese, pancetta, and black pepper. A Roman classic that's ready in under 30 minutes!
ingredients: 100g Pecorino Romano or Parmesan, finely grated
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook spaghetti until al dente.
Meanwhile, fry the pancetta in a large pan over medium heat until crispy. Remove from heat.
In a bowl, whisk together the eggs and grated cheese. Season generously with black pepper.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water, then drain the spaghetti.
Quickly add the hot spaghetti to the pancetta pan (off heat). Toss to coat.
Pour in the egg and cheese mixture, stirring quickly. Add reserved pasta water a little at a time until creamy (not scrambled!).
Serve immediately with extra cheese and black pepper on top.

title: Crispy Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Tender chicken pieces marinated in yogurt and spices, grilled to perfection, then simmered in a rich and creamy tomato curry sauce.
ingredients: 800g chicken thighs, boneless & cut into chunks
Basmati rice or naan to serve
instructions: Mix chicken with yogurt and tikka spices. Marinate for at least 1 hour (overnight is best).
Preheat grill or oven to 220°C (425°F). Thread chicken onto skewers and grill/bake for 12–15 minutes until slightly charred.
In a large pan, sauté onion, garlic, and ginger until golden.
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in cream and cooked chicken pieces. Simmer for another 10 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning. Garnish with fresh cilantro.
Serve hot with basmati rice or warm naan bread.

title: Decadent Triple Chocolate Brownies
summary: Ultra-fudgy brownies loaded with dark, milk, and white chocolate chunks. The ultimate chocolate lover's dream dessert!
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F). Line a 20cm square pan with parchment paper.
Melt dark chocolate and butter together in a microwave or over a double boiler. Let cool slightly.
Whisk in sugar, then eggs one at a time, then vanilla.
Sift in flour, cocoa powder, and salt. Fold gently until just combined.
Fold in milk and white chocolate chunks.
Pour batter into prepared pan and smooth the top.
Bake for 28–32 minutes until the top is shiny and crackly but center is still slightly gooey.
Cool completely before cutting into squares. Enjoy warm with ice cream!
